requirements.text: Large Images shall be resized to the browser window.
It shall be possible to resize an image to it's original size after it has been resized to window size.
Saving an image to local drive shall be available through right clicking.
An image shall be set as wallpaper.
An image shall be printed without changing the currently loaded page.
Images shall be properly redithered upon system bit-depth changes.
Reloaded web pages shall properly display the images modified since the last load.
Images shall load directly into the web browser from a networked server.
Images shall load directly into the web browser from a local hard drive.
Animated GIFs shall continue to animate after an extended period of 24 hours or greater.
Multiple differing animated images on the same page shall be properly displayed.
GIF 87 images shall be properly displayed across different bit depths.
GIF 89a images shall be properly displayed across different bit depths.
The web browser shall gracefully deal with unusual, corrupted, or invalid GIF images.
X Bitmap (XBM) format images shall be displayed.
Applets shall be run within <applet> and <object> tags.

generated_cases.title: Resize Large Image to Browser Window
generated_cases.description: Verify that large images are automatically resized to fit the browser window boundaries (Equivalence partition: valid image dimensions exceeding window size).

generated_cases.title: Restore Image to Original Size
generated_cases.description: Verify that an image resized to window size can be successfully restored back to its original dimensions (Equivalence partition: valid restore action on resized image).

generated_cases.title: Save Image via Right Click
generated_cases.description: Verify that right-clicking an image provides the option to save the image to the local drive (Equivalence partition: valid context menu action).

generated_cases.title: Set Image as Wallpaper
generated_cases.description: Verify that an image can be successfully configured and set as the desktop wallpaper (Equivalence partition: valid wallpaper setting action).

generated_cases.title: Print Image Without Changing Loaded Page
generated_cases.description: Verify that an image can be printed while the currently loaded web page remains unchanged in the background (Equivalence partition: valid background print action).

generated_cases.title: Redither Images on System Bit-Depth Change
generated_cases.description: Verify that images are properly redithered when the operating system bit-depth settings are modified (Equivalence partition: valid system environment change).

generated_cases.title: Display Modified Images on Page Reload
generated_cases.description: Verify that reloaded web pages correctly display images that have been modified since the last load (Equivalence partition: valid cache/reload state).

generated_cases.title: Load Images from Networked Server
generated_cases.description: Verify that images load directly into the browser from a remote networked server (Equivalence partition: valid network source).

generated_cases.title: Load Images from Local Hard Drive
generated_cases.description: Verify that images load directly into the browser from a local hard drive source (Equivalence partition: valid local file source).

generated_cases.title: Extended Animation of GIFs
generated_cases.description: Verify that animated GIFs continue to animate correctly after an extended period of 24 hours or greater (Equivalence partition: valid long-duration animation state).

generated_cases.title: Multiple Differing Animated Images
generated_cases.description: Verify that multiple differing animated images present on the same page are properly displayed and animated simultaneously (Equivalence partition: valid multi-animation page).

generated_cases.title: Display GIF 87 Images Across Bit Depths
generated_cases.description: Verify that GIF 87 images are properly displayed across different system bit depths (Equivalence partition: valid GIF 87 format across varying bit depths).

generated_cases.title: Display GIF 89a Images Across Bit Depths
generated_cases.description: Verify that GIF 89a images are properly displayed across different system bit depths (Equivalence partition: valid GIF 89a format across varying bit depths).

generated_cases.title: Graceful Handling of Invalid GIFs
generated_cases.description: Verify that the browser gracefully handles unusual, corrupted, or invalid GIF images without crashing (Equivalence partition: invalid or corrupted image data class).

generated_cases.title: Display X Bitmap Images
generated_cases.description: Verify that X Bitmap (XBM) format images are successfully decoded and displayed (Equivalence partition: valid XBM format).

generated_cases.title: Run Applets Within Tags
generated_cases.description: Verify that applets are successfully executed when enclosed within <applet> and <object> tags (Equivalence partition: valid applet container tags).

generated_cases.title: Applet Lifecycle Management
generated_cases.description: Verify that applets maintain a proper lifecycle including initialization, starting, stopping, and destruction (Equivalence partition: valid applet lifecycle states).

generated_cases.title: Animated GIF duration at exactly 24 hours
generated_cases.description: Verify animated GIFs continue to animate after exactly 24 hours.

generated_cases.title: Animated GIF duration just under 24 hours
generated_cases.description: Verify animated GIFs continue to animate at 23 hours and 59 minutes.

generated_cases.title: Animated GIF duration just over 24 hours
generated_cases.description: Verify animated GIFs continue to animate at 24 hours and 1 minute.

generated_cases.title: State Transition - Large Image Resize to Original Size
generated_cases.description: Transition from original loaded image state to resized window state, and then perform transition back to original size.

generated_cases.title: State Transition - Context Menu Actions on Image
generated_cases.description: Verify states and transitions for saving an image to local drive and setting it as wallpaper via right-clicking.

generated_cases.title: State Transition - Printing Image Without Page Reload
generated_cases.description: Verify the print state transition maintains the currently loaded page state without changing it.

generated_cases.title: State Transition - System Bit-Depth Change Redithering
generated_cases.description: Transition the system bit-depth state while displaying images and verify proper redithering across GIF 87, GIF 89a, and general images.

generated_cases.title: State Transition - Page Reload with Modified Images
generated_cases.description: Transition from loaded page state to reloaded web page state, ensuring modified images are properly displayed.

generated_cases.title: State Transition - Image Loading from Network and Local Drive
generated_cases.description: Verify loading states directly into the browser from a networked server and a local hard drive.

generated_cases.title: State Transition - Extended Animated GIF and Multiple GIFs
generated_cases.description: Verify continuous animation state transitions over 24 hours or greater, and handling of multiple differing animated images.

generated_cases.title: State Transition - Abnormal Handling of Corrupted GIFs and XBM Display
generated_cases.description: Verify graceful state handling for unusual, corrupted, or invalid GIF images, alongside proper display of X Bitmap format images.

generated_cases.title: State Transition - Applet Tags and Lifecycle
generated_cases.description: Verify states and transitions for running applets within <applet> and <object> tags through their full lifecycle.

generated_cases.title: End-to-End Image Loading and Viewing Workflow
generated_cases.description: User loads a web page containing images from both a networked server and a local hard drive, verifies large images are resized to the browser window, toggles back to the original size, and triggers a page reload to check modified images.

generated_cases.title: Image Context Menu Actions Workflow
generated_cases.description: User interacts with an image via right-clicking to save the image to the local drive, sets the image as wallpaper, and prints the image without changing the currently loaded page.

generated_cases.title: System Display Adaptation and Redithering Workflow
generated_cases.description: User performs system bit-depth changes while viewing images and verifies that standard images are properly redithered, and GIF 87 and GIF 89a images are properly displayed across the different bit depths.

generated_cases.title: Animated Images Extended Playback and Display Workflow
generated_cases.description: User loads a web page with multiple differing animated images and observes their continuous animation over an extended period of 24 hours or greater.

generated_cases.title: Abnormal and Special Image Format Handling Workflow
generated_cases.description: User loads pages containing unusual, corrupted, or invalid GIF images to ensure graceful handling, and views X Bitmap format images along with executing applets within appropriate tags.

generated_cases.title: Resize large image and attempt invalid restore
generated_cases.description: Verify that after resizing a large image to the browser window, attempting to resize it to its original size using malformed inputs or unexpected user interactions handles errors gracefully.

generated_cases.title: Save image during rapid context menu switching
generated_cases.description: Guess potential failure conditions by rapidly invoking right-click to save an image to the local drive while the context menu is being dismissed.

generated_cases.title: Print image with background page modification
generated_cases.description: Attempt to trigger a page modification or navigation while an image print job is initiated to ensure the currently loaded page remains unchanged.

generated_cases.title: Load corrupted and malformed GIF images
generated_cases.description: Feed heavily corrupted, truncated, or invalid GIF files into the browser to verify graceful error handling without crashing.

generated_cases.title: Applet execution with missing tags and broken lifecycle
generated_cases.description: Test applet execution with malformed or incomplete <applet> and <object> tags to check error resilience during lifecycle state transitions.

reference_cases.title: TC-090
reference_cases.description:
INITIAL CONDITIONS
System under test should be capable of 8-bit color (256 colors), 16-bit and 24 bit

STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. Launch Netscape 6
2. View the test case page (linked below)
3. Change the system resolution to 8-bit color (256 colors)
4. Change the system resolution to 16-bit color (65536 colors)
5. Change the system resolution to 24-bit color (16 million colors)

EXPECTED RESULTS
After Step 2, the page should be properly dithered to 8-bit color
After Step 3, the page should be properly dithered to 16-bit color.
After Step 4, the page should be properly rendered in 24-bit color.
(After steps 2, 3 and 4, "proper" rendering or dithering means that the colors should appear as accurate or more accurate than when this test case is viewed in Communicator 4.x or Internet Explorer 5.x.)

LINKS
img_dither.html

reference_cases.title: TC-091
reference_cases.description:
INITIAL CONDITIONS
Disk and memory caches to be cleared. Write access to test case directory required.

STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. Copy img-reload.html, foo_master.jpg and bar_master.jpg from the test case directory to your local test case directory.
2. In your test case directory, copy (but do not rename!) foo_master.jpg to foo.jpg
3. View img_reload.html.
4. In the test case directory, copy (but do not rename!) bar_master.jpg to foo.jpg
5. Hold the shift button down, and press the browser's Reload button

EXPECTED RESULTS:
After Step 2, a page should appear containing a picture of John Glenn in a Mercury capsule.
After Step 4, a page should appear containing a picture of a (much older) John Glenn aboard the space shuttle.

LINKS
img-reload.html
bar_master.jpg
foo_master.jpg

reference_cases.title: TC-101
reference_cases.description:
INITIAL CONDITIONS
1. Open the Java console from Tasks | Tools |  Java Console menu
2. While performing every test, hit the BACK button and FORWARD button in the browser and observe results in browser window or console

STEPS/DESCRIPTION
Click the following testcase links
1. Test 1. Observe the clock display the system time on your machine. Hit BACK and FORWARD button and see that time changes and you see a different time with every visit.
2. Test 2. Hit BACK and FORWARD button on this page and observe that the init, start and stop methods are called in that order in java console.
3. Test 3. Hit BACK and FORWARD button on this page and observe that the init, start and stop methods are called in that order in java console.

technique_rationales.equivalence_partitioning: Required to test input partitions for image loading sources such as networked servers and local hard drives.
technique_rationales.boundary_value_analysis: Required to test stated limits such as extended periods of animation of 24 hours or greater.
technique_rationales.state_transition: Required to cover applet lifecycles and image sizing states like original size versus window size.
technique_rationales.use_case: Required to cover user flows such as right-clicking to save an image, setting a wallpaper, and printing.
technique_rationales.error_guessing: Required to test plausible failures like unusual, corrupted, or invalid GIF images.
